title: SAP S/4HANA Implementation Consultant
description:
Crossing Hurdles is a global recruitment firm partnering with leading organisations to hire top talent across industries. We are currently hiring for a SAP Cloud Transformation Consultant Architect role on behalf of our client.
 



  





**Quick overview** 




**Position:** 
 SAP Cloud Transformation Consultant Architect
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Compensation:** 
 As per Industry Standards / Based on Experience
 



**Required Experience:** 
 8 10\+ Years in SAP consulting with a strong focus on S/4HANA Public Cloud.
 



**Working Days:** 
 Hybrid WFH (Selected candidates will need to travel to Jaipur for a 2 3 week onsite assessment)
 



**Location:** 
 Any Location in India
 



  





**Role Responsibilities** 



* Perform deep\-dive assessments of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud processes, controls, configurations, and integrations.
* Analyze current\-state implementation maturity against business processes and stakeholder expectations.
* Identify functional, technical, process, reporting, and master data gaps.
* Review workflows, interfaces, automation opportunities, and reporting challenges.
* Define stabilization, recovery, and implementation completion roadmaps.
* Recommend process optimization, control improvements, and remediation plans.
* Validate SAP FICO \& MM configurations, integrations, and reporting structures.
* Support remediation of master data quality and structural issues.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, and implementation partners.
* Drive implementation stabilization, business adoption, and Go\-Live re\-adoption support.
* Provide functional guidance, user support, training, and hypercare assistance.
* Assist in defining the future\-state operating model, transformation roadmap, and required skillsets.



  





**Requirements** 



* 8 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP consulting with a strong focus on S/4HANA Public Cloud.
* Deep expertise in SAP FICO and MM modules configuration, integration, and reporting.
* Proven experience in SAP implementation assessments, gap analysis, and stabilization projects.
* Strong understanding of business process design, master data management, and workflow automation.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams including business stakeholders and implementation partners.
* Ability to define and execute transformation roadmaps and future\-state operating models.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Prior experience in Go\-Live support, hypercare, and business adoption programs is a plus.
* Willingness to travel to Jaipur for a 2 3 week onsite assessment when required.



  





**Application Process** 



* Fill out the Google Form shared by us.
* Prescreening conducted by our team.
* Shortlisted profiles reviewed by the client; approved candidates are contacted for interviews and the next stages.
* 3\-4 interview rounds (a mix of technical and managerial).
* Final discussion and offer.
